Description: A GitHub repository as the workflow's workspace: cloned into the run's workspace before launch, browsable over the GitHub API.

Settings.Label: Repository URL
Settings.HelpText: HTTPS URL of the repository, e.g. https://github.com/acme/widget — cloned into the run's workspace before launch.

Settings.Label: GitHub account
Settings.HelpText: The connected GitHub account (or a pasted personal access token); only needed for private repositories. Stored encrypted and never displayed back.

Settings.Label: Branch
Settings.HelpText: Branch the workflow reads from; the repository's 'main' branch is used when empty.

Settings.Label: Mount into workspace
Settings.HelpText: Clone the repository into the run's workspace so the workflow works on real files; turn off for API-only access.
